metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy blinked out of existence LOL Valorant logic
metadata.description:
Wait, did that just count as a kill?
Enemy must’ve been AFK or glitching.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the killfeed’s still lit.
Valorant logic: serving free kills since forever.

Tap if you’ve ever won a fight you didn’t practice for!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
